```sql
SELECT 
    SUM(line_total) / COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_id) AS answer
FROM staging.stg_pos__transaction_lines t
JOIN staging.stg_erp__stores s ON t.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE s.store_name ILIKE '%Melbourne%'
  AND t.txn_date >= '2026-02-01'
  AND t.txn_date <= '2026-02-28'
  AND t.txn_type = 'SALE'
  AND t.is_valid = true;
```
